title: PageSpec
description: A page composition. mode=clone reconstructs the source (real copy/assets allowed as evidence); mode=generation builds a new page for another brand and is checked by the GENERATION_MODE_* rules in schema/semantic_validate.py. Styling is owned by the section/component contracts; the only style input is the closed node.tokens slot map (approved token ids).

mode.description: clone = faithful reconstruction of the source; generation = a new page that must not contain the source's identity or content.

tokenRefs.description: Slot -> approved token id (tokens/llm/token-policy.json slots). Values are checked by the TOKEN_* rules in the semantic validator.

retrievalEligible.description: Optional echo of the section contract's retrieval eligibility; must agree with it (pinned in the validators).

assetRef.description: Optional pointer to the file: a registered asset path (mode=clone only) or placeholder:/generated:/user-supplied:<id>.
